7838.title: Interaction payload error classification
7838.rootCauseOneLine: A shared catch identifies size errors by exception text, so serializer failures containing the limit string bypass normalization.

prReviews.verdict: Static approach addresses the cause; closed and unmerged
prReviews.topFinding: No branch execution; separate trusted-base regression reproduced the bug.

7838.proposedFix: Catch serialization failures separately and enforce the unchanged byte limit outside that catch.
7838.caveats: Uses a newly authored getter-based serializer failure instead of executing the issue's custom-conversion example. Repeated by the same agent in a second clean checkout. Complete test and output are inline; no live app was required.
